data.narrative:
Radian Aerospace is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $27.5M to date. The valuation universe includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 identifiable private peers in the Space & Aerospace sector, though a narrow same-stage peer set does not exist with sufficient density for reliable median anchoring.

Of three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. Using total capital raised ($27.5M) as a proxy for entry valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $69M. Public comparables in Space & Aerospace trade at a median P/S multiple of 27.4x across six tickers, but Radian's revenue is not disclosed, precluding direct application of this anchor. A Peer-Median approach failed due to absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage private comparables; applying an all-sector median would introduce material noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $58M (low) to $79M (high), centered on $69M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the Stage-Progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, which prevents triangulation via public multiples, and the scarcity of seed-stage comparable transactions in the Space & Aerospace sector. Validation would benefit from proprietary transaction data or disclosed milestone-based metrics.
